record_verdict=defective. Two of six claims are unsupported and both are GF claims: the shared-fryer warning and, worse, the 'tofu steak can be prepared gluten-free' reassurance, which traces to the LONDON menu. Meanwhile the record misses the barley (大麦) in the house zakkoku rice that its own cited kyototwo article names. vegan:full is well supported (動物性食品、乳製品…一切使用せず, egg-free noodles). Venue is trading: itadakizen-uk.com/kyoto lists six days a week, HappyCow reviews run to 07 Jun 2026. Recommend gf_confidence be re-derived from Kyoto-only evidence.
